fixes.change:
Replace build note 8 with this text, verbatim:
'The test harness.
Arm: set in index.html's inline snippet, on the line after it mints naira_vid, before fbq("init") and before React: window.__nfArm = (parseInt(id.replace(/[^0-9a-f]/gi, "").slice(-1), 16) & 1) ? "pdp_b" : "pdp_a". naira_vid is already random (crypto.randomUUID, or the v-<time>-<random> fallback), so its last hex digit is a fair coin. No hash is needed, and crypto.subtle.digest is asynchronous, so it could not decide the layout before JewelDetail renders. A returning visitor keeps her cookie and her arm. Arm B renders on mobile widths only. Desktop, and any page where __nfArm is missing, renders arm A and tags its events "unassigned"; those are left out of the read.
Visitors: meta-capi already receives ViewContent, AddToCart and InitiateCheckout with an event_id and the visitor id (external_id). For the test it also inserts one row per relayed event from a /jewellery/ page into a Supabase table pdp_test_events: event_id (primary key), event_name, vid_hash (SHA-256 of naira_vid, computed server-side), arm, handle, value, num_items, ua_class, created_at. The page sends arm and ua_class in custom_data. This table is the only place the per-visitor rates by arm exist: Meta's dataset stats split only by event, device and host.
Orders: add { key: "nf_arm", value: arm }, { key: "nf_route", value: "buy_now" | "bag" } and { key: "nf_ua", value: ua_class } to trackingCartAttributes() and fastrrCartAttributes(). fastrr.ts L189-192 already relies on Fastrr orders keeping these cart attributes. Ops confirms with one test order that all three reach order.customAttributes. If they do not, each order is joined to the last InitiateCheckout row whose content_ids match its line items, within 60 minutes before the order, and the match rate is reported. meta-capi never receives Purchase (guard.ts RELAYED_EVENTS; index.ts L77), so no join may rely on a Purchase event.
ua_class is instagram, facebook or other, by android or ios, from the user agent (Instagram; FBAN|FBAV).
Read per visitor, never per event: visitors with an AddToCart / visitors with a ViewContent; visitors with an InitiateCheckout / visitors with an AddToCart; Shopify orders / visitors with a ViewContent. Check the split every day: a chi-square on ViewContent visitors per arm, and stop and fix at p < 0.001. Freeze promo.ts and BUY2/BUY3/BUY4 for the whole test.'
Script L700: keep 'pdp_b' as the prototype's own fallback, with the comment '/* prototype only: the live build falls back to "unassigned", never to an arm */'.
fixes.why:
Test validity. This note is all that stands between this page and the owner's decision, and as written the test cannot be read.
(a) It states something false about the codebase, and it is my round-5 text. supabase/functions/meta-capi/guard.ts L33-48 lists the relayed events without Purchase ('a Purchase here can only be forged'), and index.ts L77-84 rejects it. So the fallback join 'on the Purchase event' does not exist.
(b) Its decision metrics have no source. Pixel aggregation returns event, device_type or the host only (research_data.md section 0), so AddToCart by arm cannot be read from Meta. meta-capi forwards and stores nothing. Clarity tags give sessions, not a funnel.
(c) SHA-256 in the browser is a Promise, so the arm could not be decided before the first render without flicker or a render block. naira_vid is minted synchronously as crypto.randomUUID() in index.html L106-116 and is already uniform.
nf_route and nf_ua answer the two open questions this page cannot see past Fastrr:
- Do Buy-now COD orders, which never see the fee on our pages, complete and RTO differently (launch blocker 4)?
- Does Android's checkout gap (Purchase/IC 16.6% against 27.9% on iPhone, research_data 1c) sit in the Instagram webview?

TEST 1, the new template against honest arm A, mobile only, on every jewellery PDP. It is read from pdp_test_events and Shopify orders (fix 1).
- Size it on the first week's real visitors per arm. Power it on InitiateCheckout per visitor (from ~3.0%, +20% needs ~13,900 visitors per arm). Read orders per visitor as probability-to-beat after at least 4 weeks.
- Expected: AddToCart per visitor +10 to +20%; InitiateCheckout per adder −5 to +5% (one more tap, and the fee shown before checkout); orders per InitiateCheckout +5 to +15%; items per order from 1.51 to 1.6-1.7; COD share −3 to −6 points.
- Guardrails: the daily sample-ratio check; orders per InitiateCheckout on Android, split by nf_ua (Instagram webview against other); cancellations; RTO matured at 3 weeks.
TEST 2 (unchanged): the card plus 'Bag & checkout' against an auto-opened bag that carries the 'Wear it with' row. Primary: orders per adding visitor.

TEST 7, new, inside arm B: the next rung as one tap in 2- and 3-piece bags. Today's text-only top line is tested against a 'Wear it with' row placed under the total, like the one-piece row: 'Prism Pear Drop Necklace · PVD 18K gold coating · 3 in stock · Adds ₹460, not ₹999 · 20% off all three' with + ADD. The row is guarded for 700 ms and never replaced under the finger until the bag is reopened. Primary: items per order and revenue per bag viewer. Guardrail: InitiateCheckout per bag viewer.
